description: Flutter QA — four deterministic checks and no judge: `flutter analyze` (the project's own lint set, errors and warnings enforced in the turn's own files), the project's own `flutter test` suite, file/widget separation read from the Dart (one widget per file, named after its class, reusable widgets that do not navigate), and routing (every @RoutePage screen registered in a router, no hand-edited .gr.dart). Generated routes are regenerated in prepare() so both the analyzer and the routing facts are answerable on the first pass.
